This process improves the timing of the netlist by decreasing the distance between timing-critical cells, but it also causes an increase in gpl runtime due to running timing analysis.

question_0.gt_answer: In OpenROAD, database units (DBU) are an integer representation of distance on a chip. For example, if a technology used a conversion factor of 2000 DBU/micron, that would mean that each DBU represents 0.0005 micron or 0.5 nm. The purpose for using DBU is that it enables faster calculation and no loss of precision compared to floating point representations.
